WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
    FROM account_order_counts
), account_differences AS (
    SELECT aoc.account_id, aoc.region, aoc.order_count,
           aoc.order_count - oa.avg_count AS difference_from_overall
    FROM account_order_counts AS aoc
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(difference_from_overall) AS avg_difference
    FROM account_differences
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT ad.account_id, ad.region, ad.order_count,
       ad.difference_from_overall,
       ad.difference_from_overall - ra.avg_difference AS excess_over_region_average
FROM account_differences AS ad
JOIN region_averages AS ra ON ra.region = ad.region
WHERE ad.difference_from_overall > ra.avg_difference
ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
